name: HPV01a. Partial (HPV 1 only)
description:
Children active on ART with Partial HPV vaccination status
Number of children who are active on ART and have a documented HPV vaccination status of Partial, meaning HPV dose 1 has been received but the vaccination schedule has not yet been completed.
The patient must be active in ART care, defined as having an ART encounter between :startDate and :endDate or having a return_visit_date extending beyond :endDate. The patient must have an ART-card encounter during the reporting quarter with hpvVacStatus = 'Partial'. Each patient is counted once.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card h
WHERE h.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card h
WHERE h.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND h.hpvVacStatus = 'Partial'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND (
            a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
